# Venus beautiful — Private Label Eye Makeup Supplier

> Venus beautiful is the export brand of Chuangyuan Cosmetics Manufacturing (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd., a Shenzhen, China manufacturer of lash serum, mascara, liquid eyeliner, and cosmetic packaging. We supply beauty brands, wholesalers, importers, and ecommerce sellers with ready stock, light customization, private label, and OEM order support. This is a B2B supply site; we do not sell retail quantities to consumers.

## Products and services
- [Cosmetics contract manufacturer](https://cyeyemakeup.com/cosmetics-contract-manufacturer): one sourcing route for lash serum, mascara, liquid eyeliner, brow gel, and matched packaging, with formula review, sampling, filling, decoration, and export-document coordination.
- [Private label lash serum](https://cyeyemakeup.com/private-label-lash-serum): formula directions (best-seller, fast-routine, gentle peptide), 3ml/6ml standard capacities with 1.5-10ml customization, precision brush applicator, vegan/herbal/organic ingredient directions.
- [Lash serum manufacturer](https://cyeyemakeup.com/lash-serum-manufacturer): manufacturing, samples, packaging, lead time, and label claim review support.
- [Private label mascara](https://cyeyemakeup.com/private-label-mascara-manufacturer): 4D volumizing, volumizing+lengthening, lengthening fiber, and transparent keratin formula directions; nylon, silicone, gourd-shaped, and crescent-shaped brushes.
- [Private label eyeliner](https://cyeyemakeup.com/private-label-eyeliner-manufacturer): black/brown liquid pens, lash-conditioning positioning, and glue-style formula development; water-resistance and smudge claims require approved samples or test evidence.
- [Private label brow gel](https://cyeyemakeup.com/private-label-brow-gel): clear, tinted, and styling directions with brush, tube, decoration, sample, MOQ, and claim-review choices for brow-product buyers.
- [Cosmetic packaging](https://cyeyemakeup.com/cosmetic-packaging-manufacturer): mascara tubes, eyeliner pens, dropper bottles, brow gel tubes, blush compacts; silkscreen, UV printing, hot stamping, laser carving, electroplating decoration.
- [Wholesale lash serum](https://cyeyemakeup.com/wholesale-lash-serum), [wholesale mascara](https://cyeyemakeup.com/wholesale-mascara), [wholesale eyeliner](https://cyeyemakeup.com/wholesale-eyeliner)

## Order facts
- Selected mascara formulas using available standard black or white tubes start from 500 units. Other tube colors can start from 500 units only when combined production is available; without a suitable combined run, the normal custom-color tube MOQ is 10,000 units. Mascara sample development normally takes 10-15 days and bulk production by our manufacturing partner normally takes 20-40 days after approval.
- Formula matching is available from a customer brief, ingredient list, benchmark sample, or customer-provided formula. The closest feasible direction is confirmed through technical review, samples, formula-specific documents, and destination-market checks; an exact match is not guaranteed.
- Payment: 30% deposit and 70% balance before shipment by T/T; express, air, and sea shipping.
- Private label and OEM orders have been supplied to buyers in the US, Canada, UK, Germany, France, Austria, Netherlands, Poland, Russia, Philippines, Thailand, Singapore, Vietnam, and Australia.
- Compliance verification: current facility credentials, ISO 22716 scope and validity, audits, CPNP support, formula-specific MSDS, and market documents are checked for the selected order. See [Compliance support](https://cyeyemakeup.com/certifications).

## Information scope and verification
- Last reviewed: 2026-09-11. Product, packaging, facility, and document details come from current Chuangyuan and qualified manufacturing-partner materials used for B2B quotation support.
- MOQ, sample cost, capacity, color availability, lead time, formula, test evidence, and destination-market documents are order-specific. The approved quotation, sample, specification, artwork, and applicable documents control the final order.
- Product names, page headings, images, and marketplace labels are selection aids rather than proof of an unverified performance, regulatory, or certification claim.
- Use the linked product page for the full buying context and [Compliance support](https://cyeyemakeup.com/certifications) for the scope and verification status of credentials.
